summary: The PrfEmailMessages file is part of the staff profile user control system, involving email message functionalities such as viewing, editing, adding, and deleting staff messages.
purpose: To manage staff email messages within the HSPnet application, allowing users to perform various operations on messages including viewing, editing, adding, and deleting.

workflows.name: Email Message Management
steps: User selects an action on the email messages such as view, edit, add, or delete.
The system processes the request based on user session data and inputs.
Data binding occurs to display and manage message details.
Appropriate buttons are enabled or disabled based on editability of the screen.
User actions (add, edit, delete) trigger commands that modify message data.

business_rules: Screen must be editable for adding new data.
No data message appears when data grid is empty and screen is editable.
validations: Page validity is checked before completing add or edit operations.
User session must be active and valid for data operations.
conditions: Visibility of buttons based on screen editability.
Command names vary depending on the form mode (edit/insert).
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields are to be modified in code-behind not designer files.
Session caching occurs after certain user actions to preserve state.
exceptions: Operation cancellation if user session is null or page is invalid.
content_gaps: The specific details of the data schema for StaffMessage are not provided.
